notes: Separate canonical groups all prefer 唐昭宗 as a Tang ruler with overlapping late-Tang dates, but the dossier attests only temple/regnal naming, not a shared personal name.
Target 唐昭宗 and the large already-merged 昭宗 Tang-emperor group share temple name and Tang dates only.
Preferred Chinese forms 昭皇 versus 唐昭宗 differ; matching English title alone is not identity evidence.
Only shared label is descriptive kinship 'son of Wang Yan'; p003 has no personal name while p035 is 漢倫, with Former Shu 926 vs Later Zhou 951.
Both are labeled Empress of Zhuangzong in Later Tang (AD 926 vs 939), but only title/kinship forms are attested, not a personal name.
Later Tang empress records near AD 924–926 share only the title 皇后/empress; dossier gives no personal name or attested alias linking them.
